title: football game in a big arena by ckater
author: ckater
sourceDescription: Recorded in Hanover, Germany in a big arena. People are chanting and cheering and there are some missed changes for a goal. Nice, bright atmo. I think it was recorded on a Tascam DR-100. No edition or processing afterwards.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -4.50 dBFS); 30 ms fades
